footer.tagline: Autonomous sales intelligence for revenue teams who don't have time to go looking for the signal — only to act on it.

landing.heroTitle: Sales intelligence that decides in real time.
landing.heroSubtitle: BEE watches the market, prioritizes your pipeline and prepares the next play while you close.

signal.title: The signal arrives.
signal.text: A funding round, a key hire, a stack change. BEE detects it, scores it and places it in the hive before the lead exists.

play.title: BEE prepares the play.
play.text: Argument, channel and timing, ready on one card. The rep reads and decides; no research from scratch.

execute.title: You decide, BEE executes.
execute.text: Nothing goes out without your approval. With it, BEE schedules the next step, follows it up and learns from the outcome.

landing.closingTitle: Your next customer is already sending signals. The question is whether you're seeing them.
